content: The two hyper-parameters that control the trade-off between performance and number of parameters in PRUs are the number of pyramidal levels INLINEFORM0 and groups INLINEFORM1 . Figure FIGREF35 provides a trade-off between perplexity and recurrent unit (RU) parameters.
